auxiliary.description: The voice overlay and picture-in-picture windows: they move, size and close themselves, and open nothing

default.description: Raven's main window: window controls, opening links in the system browser, creating its picture-in-picture windows, and every Raven command (the generated main-window set; see app_commands.rs)

picture-in-picture.description: Picture-in-picture windows' Raven commands; their window permissions are in auxiliary.json

secondary.description: Nest and Studio windows (not opened by the current UI): window controls only. They cannot open further windows; the Studio window gets the mixer commands from studio.json

voice-overlay.description: The voice overlay's Raven commands; its window permissions are in auxiliary.json
